notes: Adds a lightweight offline SET card-game reference under Quick Reference > Games / SET. The guide is based on the supplied instruction booklet and includes the four features, the all-same-or-all-different rule, play sequence, easy-start variation, scoring/penalty guidance, solitaire variation, and three schematic visual SET examples plus a non-SET quick check. The guide is included in the Quick Reference offline cache and does not reproduce the original instruction artwork.
name: TEE v3.5.29 — SET Offline Game Guide
